name: iso-42002-ai-risk-assessment-suite
known_facts: AI risk categories: technical, operational, ethical/societal, and compliance/regulatory
ISO 23894 provides AI risk management guidance
NIST AI RMF 1.0 is a complementary framework
Inherent risk is assessed without controls; residual risk is assessed with controls
AI risk indicators (ARIs) require continuous monitoring thresholds
Adversarial inputs, data poisoning, model inversion, and jailbreaking are technical AI risks
Algorithmic bias and fairness must address intersectional attributes
Hallucination risk requires RAG, grounding, and output validation
EU AI Act penalties can reach 7% of global turnover
AI incidents affecting fundamental rights require regulatory notification

input.ai_system_full_description: Multilingual customer support chatbot using Azure OpenAI GPT-4o with RAG on knowledge base. Handles refunds, order status, account changes, and product recommendations.
